name: Filesystem MCP Server
what: Reference MCP server that lets an AI read, write, edit, move and search files and directories, restricted to the folders you allow.
who: People who want Claude Desktop or another chat app to work with files on their computer.

setup.text: Add the server, listing as many allowed folders as you need. On Windows, launch it through cmd /c npx.
Only list folders you're happy for the AI to access. If your client supports MCP Roots, it can set the allowed folders for you. Restart the client afterwards.

prompts: Find every markdown file in my notes folder that mentions 'invoice'.
Show me a directory tree of my project folder, excluding node_modules.
Read my README and suggest a clearer intro, then preview the edit before applying it.
